model: ReliaTel BCI-R - touch-screen zone sensor points
equipment_type: Rooftop unit controller (zone sensor interaction subset)
applies_to: Trane Precedent, Voyager 2/3 and Odyssey single-zone units on ReliaTel controls with a BCI-R board, used with the commercial touch-screen programmable zone sensor.
summary: This short list shows which ReliaTel BCI-R objects the Trane commercial touch-screen programmable zone sensor reads and overrides on single-zone packaged units. It covers space temperature, setpoints and offset, heat/cool mode request and status, occupancy request, fan mode, economizer enable setpoints and the BAS control flag. The sensor and BCI-R talk BACnet MS/TP.
firmware: RTRM 19.2 or later, BCI-R 6.0 or later
notes: This is a SUBSET: only the BCI-R objects the touch-screen zone sensor uses (Table 4 of BAS-SVP080A, p15). The full BCI-R list is a separate entry (BCI-R ReliaTel).
Access is inferred: the doc has no read/write column. Output and multistate-output objects the sensor writes are shown as W; inputs as R.

The sensor sets Out_Of_Service on most of these objects at power-up and writes them at priority 7. AO 41/AO 42 Out_Of_Service is set from the sensor setup menu (In Use / Not Used) and should be written only once, not refreshed.
AO 30 on ReliaTel is the standby offset (occupied offset plus shed offset, max 10 °F); the guide uses it because the BCI-R occupied offset object is limited to 5 °F.
Matching sensor objects (AV 100, AV 44, AV 43, MV 140, MV 16, MV 112, MI 33, MV 17, AV 260, AV 261) belong to the sensor itself. Multiple-zone units (RTAM board) are not supported.

integration.summary: Use the BMS mainly for monitoring and alarms when the touch-screen sensor runs the unit. The sensor owns occupancy, mode, fan and setpoint commands; read mode status and fan speed, and only write Space Temperature BAS (priority 5 or higher) if the BMS must supply space temperature.

minimum_points.name: Supply Fan Configuration Command
minimum_points.why: Fan mode: Inactive = Auto, Active = On

minimum_points.name: Space Temperature BAS
minimum_points.why: Space temperature in use by the unit

integration.enable: BO 1 System Control Command defaults to Inactive (standalone); the sensor writes Active (BAS control) at power-up. The sensor then holds the occupancy, mode, fan and setpoint objects Out_Of_Service and writes them at priority 7. The guide recommends leaving control with the sensor.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature BAS normally comes from the sensor; a BMS can command it at priority 5 or higher (priority 6 is reserved for minimum on/off). Space Temperature Local is the unit's hard-wired sensor.
setup: The sensor talks BACnet MS/TP only; default baud 76800 (leave the default).
Sensor and unit controller should share an MS/TP link where possible to reduce communication loss.
Trane best practice device ID: MS/TP network number followed by the MAC address (e.g. network 11, MAC 001 = 11001).
Needs ReliaTel RTRM software 19.2 or later and BCI-R software 6.0 or later.
gotchas: The sensor holds these points Out_Of_Service and writes them at priority 7; a BMS writing the same points will fight the sensor.
BO 1 does not need periodic refresh; the sensor writes it once at power-up.

source.title: Touch Screen Programmable Zone Sensor Integration Guide (Tracer UC400-B, Symbio 400-B/500/700/800, ReliaTel)

points.name: Space Temperature BAS
points.description: Space temperature sent by the touch-screen sensor, -40-150 °F

points.name: Space Temperature Local (TempRemSrc)
points.description: Hard-wired space temperature at the unit, -40-200 °F

points.name: Heat Cool Mode Request BAS
points.description: Heat/cool mode request written by the sensor (default Auto)
points.states: 1=Auto, 2=Heat, 3=Morning Warm-up, 4=Cool, 5=Night Purge, 6=Precool, 7=Off, 8=Test, 9=Emergency Heat, 10=Fan Only, 11=Free Cool, 12=Ice Making, 13=Max Heat, 14=Economy Mode, 15=Dehumidifying, 16=Calibrate

points.name: Heat Cool Mode Status BAS
points.description: Actual heat/cool mode of the unit
points.states: 1=Auto, 2=Heat, 3=Morning Warm-up, 4=Cool, 5=Night Purge, 6=Precool, 7=Off, 8=Test, 9=Emergency Heat, 10=Fan Only, 11=Free Cool, 12=Ice Making, 13=Max Heat, 14=Economy Mode, 15=Dehumidifying, 16=Calibrate

points.name: Occupancy Request
points.description: Occupancy request written by the sensor (default Occupied)

points.name: Supply Fan Configuration Command
points.description: Fan mode: auto or continuous on (default Auto)

points.name: System Control Command
points.description: Standalone or BAS control; sensor writes Active at power-up
